params.instruction: Draw a regular octagon inscribed in a circle with vertices labelled in order A,B,C,D,E,F,G,H. Use these measured image pixel coordinates (origin top-left, y down; convert to TikZ by x'=x/100, y'=-y/100 ... i.e. use (x/100, -y/100) and scale consistently): A=(456,807), B=(708,701), C=(811,452), D=(707,202), E=(456,98), F=(206,202), G=(102,453), H=(206,703). Draw all solid black lines, thin-to-medium width (about 0.8pt): octagon sides AB, BC, CD, DE, EF, FG, GH, HA; plus interior solid segments AE (vertical diameter), EC, and CA. Name the edges as explicit paths using the named vertex coordinates (one coordinate definition per vertex). Place labels: E above, D upper-right, C right, B lower-right, A below, H lower-left, G left, F upper-left, in math mode (e.g. $E$). No right-angle marks, no dashed lines, no circle outline.
